title: This Caterpillar Freezes Solid Every Winter for Up to 7 Years

scenes.text: An Arctic caterpillar freezes solid every winter, then wakes up.
Ice forms inside its body. It is frozen like a rock.
Come spring, it thaws, crawls out, and starts eating again.
In the High Arctic, summers are so short that it can take up to seven winters to grow up.
Then spring comes, and it thaws out and goes back to eating.
Seven winters frozen solid, just to become a moth.

description:
An Arctic woolly bear caterpillar freezes solid every winter and thaws every spring.
In the High Arctic it can take up to seven winters before it finally becomes a moth.
Could you survive being frozen?
thumbnail_text: FROZEN SOLID FOR UP TO 7 WINTERS
first_comment: Would you rather freeze every winter or sleep through it like a bear?
